text: Yeah, I also find this annoying. I created a site that lets Ham Radio Parks on the Air operators share photos of their setups in parks (https://www.potaparkpics.com). I do it with no login - you simply specify what park you are in, then upload photos. I use the geolocation (comparing the photo exif against the park you said you were in) as authentication. Works great - but only for iPhone users.
